android-device-smoke.assertion: The current-fingerprint smoke proves Today accessibility-tree inspection, minimum targets, keyboard focus and activation, notification-permission denial/recovery, system-settings recovery, process restart and manual notification-time persistence. It does not exercise the native branches identified by F-001 or the complete screen matrix identified by F-002.

assets-and-design.assertion: The current asset manifest validates and the design-review check reports all 16 screens and 78 goldens complete. Changed EN/RU resources retain key parity and the changed Batch Detail golden was inspected.

batch-lifecycle-actions-delta.assertion: The selected batch lifecycle, configured recipe stages, placement, event history and terminal status now determine primary and secondary actions. The integration test walks planned, soaking, sown, ready and harvested states and asserts applicable and excluded actions. The inspected golden no longer exposes mutually inapplicable lifecycle transitions.

current-matrix.assertion: The current-fingerprint matrix passed Detekt, Android host tests, Compose compilation, SQLDelight migration verification, 78 Paparazzi goldens, Android debug/release/bundle builds, all iOS Simulator ARM64 Kotlin compilation tasks and Kover verification. Assertions and production wiring were inspected independently; execution alone was not treated as proof.

findings.failedLink: The current Pixel 8 smoke proves permission denial/recovery, keyboard activation, minimum targets, manual notification-time persistence, settings recovery and process restart, but still does not drive the real photo/document pickers, notification delivery and time-zone branches, physical reminder cancellation/erasure, or advertising eligibility/no-request behavior.
findings.smallestProof: Extend and execute the Android device suite on the frozen snapshot for photo and document picker create/open/cancel, daily and soak delivery, restart/time-zone reconciliation, terminal/reset cancellation, and eligible/ineligible ad requests and layout.
findings.summary: Android native platform coverage is incomplete.

findings.failedLink: Goldens cover RU at 200% and source tests scan semantics APIs, while the current device smoke still exercises only Today, Settings and Notifications. SCREEN-001, SCREEN-003, SCREEN-005, SCREEN-006 and SCREEN-007 lack runtime reading/focus order, keyboard activation, announcements, manual date entry and 200%-font task-completion assertions.
findings.smallestProof: Run semantic traversal, visible focus, keyboard/pointer activation, state announcements, minimum targets and 200%-font task completion across every AC-122 screen and representative form/date controls.
findings.summary: The approved accessibility and keyboard matrix is not executed.

findings.failedLink: The request explicitly marks native iOS build/platform/macOS CI execution unavailable, and the remaining Android platform, accessibility and backup-cancellation findings prevent the local release check from passing.
findings.smallestProof: Close the local Android platform, accessibility and cancellation findings, then attach successful macOS/Xcode iOS build, platform and CI evidence for the same fingerprint and rerun release closure.

findings.failedLink: The unchanged archive tests cover complete round-trip, repeated restore, malformed/unsupported/missing/corrupt photos, rollback, CSV and write failure, but no test cancels backup, validation, restore or export work and asserts that live database, files and reminders remain unchanged.
findings.smallestProof: Add deterministic cancellation tests at backup creation, archive read/validation, staged replacement and CSV write boundaries, asserting cancellation propagation and unchanged database/files/reminders.
findings.summary: QG-012 has no backup/archive cancellation proof.
